title: Session closed
description: Finalisation. This event, and only this event, establishes final usage; a transport close on its own does not.

event_id.description: Provider-assigned identifier for this server event.

client_event_id.description: The event_id of the broker command this event answers, when the broker supplied one.

reason.description: close_requested: the broker sent session.close or called hangup. expired: the provider duration limit. content: a provider safety filter. remote_hangup: the primary connection ended gracefully. connection_lost: the primary or upstream connection dropped.

session.description: The resolved session configuration. It echoes what the broker sent plus server defaults. It stays open where every other object in the profile is closed, because it echoes configuration: a new configuration field must not invalidate a running call. Only id, model, status and expires_at are read from it afterwards; the service separately compares the configuration it asked for against what came back before it admits any work.

id.description: Opaque provider session ID. Preserve its prefix.

status.description: Always active, including in the final snapshot. The event type says the session closed.

expires_at.description: Unix time in seconds at which the provider expires the session.

usage.description: Cumulative voice duration. A snapshot, never an increment to add to an earlier one.
